title: Combine configuration layers into reusable text
prompt: Please add configuration layering. textkit.config.merge_configs(texts) should accept a finite stream of config strings, let later values win, and retain each case-sensitive key in its original insertion position. Malformed lines should retain their line number within the offending text. Then add merged_config(texts) to export that merged mapping with format_config, preserving literal values, validation, and its no-trailing-newline convention. Empty input should give {} or an empty string.
parts: Merge parsed layers with stable key order and later-value precedence.
Format the merged configuration while retaining parser and formatter contracts.
